title: Decentralized LLM Workflows via Sequential Auctions
abstract: arXiv:2610.22201v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a scalable framework for solving multi-step tasks through a decentralized market of self-interested agents. Prior theoretical work demonstrated that agents organized through sequential auctions can converge to a globally optimal policy in a Markov decision process (MDP), but relied on the restrictive assumption of the existence of perfect clones as a model of perfect competition. In reality, exact clones drive agent profit to zero, violating the natural risk-reward incentives of participants. Conversely, we empirically demonstrate that the opposite extreme, absence of competition, also leads to market failure and value extraction collapse. Between these two extremes, we investigate how heterogeneous agents can survive in markets that span the critical middle ground of imperfect competition. translated_title: 基于序列拍卖的去中心化大语言模型工作流
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个可扩展的框架，通过由自利智能体组成的去中心化市场来解决多步骤任务。先前的理论工作表明，通过序列拍卖组织的智能体可以在马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中收敛到全局最优策略，但这依赖于“存在完美克隆体”这一限制性假设来建模完全竞争。在现实中，完全相同的克隆体会将智能体利润压至零，违背了参与者天然的风险-收益激励机制。相反，我们通过实证证明，另一个极端——完全缺乏竞争——同样会导致市场失灵和价值提取的崩溃。在这两个极端之间，我们研究了异构智能体如何在不完全竞争这一关键中间地带的市场中生存。为了盈利，智能体学会策略性地压低出价以获取正的个体利润率，同时仍确保市场……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个基于序列拍卖的去中心化LLM多智能体市场框架，揭示完全竞争与无竞争两个极端均会导致市场失灵，而异构智能体在不完全竞争中通过策略性出价保持正利润从而得以生存。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decentralized LLM multi-agent market framework based on sequential auctions, revealing that both perfect competition and absence of competition lead to market failure, while heterogeneous agents survive in imperfectly competitive markets by strategically shading bids to maintain positive profits.
